//exports: `./fleetRef` is the identity GRAMMAR alone — `src/fleet/ref.ts`, a leaf with no imports at all. `@kolu/acp-harness` splits a fleet reference out of a tool call and must not grow an edge to the MCP SDK, to padi-client or to effect to do it (its manifest is the ACP SDK plus kolu-common); the same split-for-weight argument `./tools` already carries one level up. `./fleetWatchJoin` is the same shape for the HOW-IT-JOINED vocabulary: `kolu-conductor` decides `ready`/`ended` from it and writes it to disk, and one tuple is what keeps a join a tool records from being a join the next boot refuses.
